old.methodology: M121 origin: [BMS] Input/Output possible power (hp), the BMS's own declared capability envelope, present only from the third raw-logging PID configuration onward (2026-08-13+). Coverage is sparse (253/665 corpus drives, 38.0%) and the channel itself is polled far less densely than ordinary BMS current/voltage (roughly 1-2% fill density within covered files), so alignment against the pipeline's I x V power series uses a wide 2s merge_asof(direction="nearest") tolerance rather than the usual V_ALIGN_TOL=1500ms. Output possible power (max discharge capability) is a hard constant across every covered file (zero exceptions) -- this corpus's driving never moved it, so no discharge-side utilization ratio is reported as a headline figure, only the descriptive utilization-against-the-fixed-ceiling stats above. Input possible power (max charge-acceptance capability) DOES vary and is the genuinely informative direction. A small number of charge-utilization values exceed 1.0, most plausibly a stale-match artefact from the wide alignment tolerance during fast current transients rather than a real BMS-limit excursion; not clipped, reported as-is.

new.methodology: Logged [BMS] Input/Output possible power, the limit the BMS reports (logged / app-calculated): the (kW) pair since 2026-09-30 and the (hp) pair before it, converted with the metric horsepower factor 0.735499 (the former mechanical factor 0.7457 put every limit 1.4 % too high); files are selected by header, not by date. Utilisation = logged I x V power (charge-positive raw, M11) aligned to the nearest possible-power sample within 2s (merge_asof nearest) divided by the BMS-reported limit; it is not a physical capability. Coverage: 432 of 665 corpus drives carry the channel (429 analysed). The channel is polled far less densely than ordinary BMS current / voltage (median gap per era in coverage.byEra), so a few utilisation values exceed 1.0, most plausibly a stale match during fast current transients; not clipped. The reported limit may be saturated at 63.75 kW (255 x 0.25 kW): 89614 of 100018 possible-power samples are at or above 63.7 kW (ceiling.byEra); this is not identified, and the statistics are also given for events with the limit below it (conditional on the denominator, not a censoring correction). Median and 95th percentile carry a day-clustered percentile bootstrap (seed 42, 4000 draws); maximum and nAbove1 are descriptive. Eras are reported side by side; no contrast between them is drawn, and nothing here shows that the limit constrained driving. Single vehicle / ~single driver.
